description:
We’re a team of mathematicians and gamers working on Be An Earth System Trend Detective. Strong on stats + coding.

Open to new members, especially someone with Earth science, remote sensing, or NASA data experience to strengthen the science side.

We enjoy a relaxed and creative atmosphere, and we also value focused work time where everyone can dig into their part. Happy to discuss ideas when it makes sense, and we like giving each other space to make progress.

Feel free to reach out!
